<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve the typical chemical shift range for methyl carbons with retrieve_carbon_shifts. By counting how many peaks in the spectrum fall within the methyl range, I can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
